title: Hong Kong Regulators Outline Next Steps for Tokenised Funds and Deposits
why_it_matters: The regulators are focusing on the connection between digital cash and tokenised investments, rather than token issuance alone. Coordinated trading and settlement infrastructure could help participating institutions use tokenised funds outside traditional operating hours, although wider commercial adoption remains a goal.
